title: Fixed site-sections comparison on Ext cocycles
statement: For a small site with abelian sheafification and Ext, the prescribed siteSectionsObjIso [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-naturality], followed by I.isoRightDerivedObj of sections for an injective resolution I [def-sp-injective-resolutions], sends I.extMk(a) to π(z) whenever a is a closed Hom cocycle from the free abelian sheaf on an object U and the sections comparison sends a to the included section cycle z. This is equality for the fixed comparison in every nonnegative degree and for every injective resolution.

source.place: Tag 06XR; Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extEquivCohomologyClass_extMk, HomComplex.leftHomologyData and rightDerived_app_eq; the actual siteSectionsObjIso definition.

proof.text: For the chosen resolution, expand extRightDerivedHomObjIso. Its two derived-resolution comparison factors cancel, leaving the explicit Ext-to-Hom-complex class equivalence. Apply extEquivCohomologyClass_extMk, unfold the left homology data, and use cycles and homology naturality to compute the representative. This gives the actual fixed map, not an existential equivalence.

For an arbitrary injective resolution, compare it with the chosen one. The Ext cocycle and usual derived-comparison naturality formulas give the same class after the comparison. Cancel its homology map, which is an isomorphism.

Transport the Hom-complex calculation through the sections natural isomorphism. Right-derived naturality and the defining siteSectionsObjIso formula identify the resulting map with the prescribed comparison.

theorem canonical_site_sections_cocycle
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}] [HasExt.{u} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (U : C) (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (p : ℕ)
    (a : (presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (yoneda.obj U ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶ I.cocomplex.X p)
    (ha : a ≫ I.cocomplex.d p (p + 1) = 0)
    (c : (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
      (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
      I.cocomplex).cycles p)
    (hc : (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
      (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
      I.cocomplex).iCycles p c = (sectionsIso J U).hom.app (I.cocomplex.X p) a) :
    ((siteSectionsObjIso J U F p).hom ≫
      (I.isoRightDerivedObj (sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
        (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U)) p).hom)
      (I.extMk a (p + 1) rfl ha) =
    (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
      (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
      I.cocomplex).homologyπ p c
